paragraphs: He is mentioned once in [Ketubot 57b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.57b.6), in a halakhic matter.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rabbi Abba bar Levi ruling on arrangements for a minor’s future marriage. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=79&lang=en) gives the same folio.
